card.name: Vial handling and preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Short linking words or verbs inside step-by-step instructions for preparing, labeling and transferring drug from a vial (e.g. to, on, the, check, Use). It fires on the word right after a handling verb or phrase.

modes.label: Transfer and labeling steps
modes.description: Small words like to or on after transfer doses or opened, in vial-entry and label-recording instructions.
modes.example: Transfer individual doses<< to>> appropriate intravenous infusion solutions.

modes.description: Words in instructions to check labels or remove vials from storage to prevent mix-ups.
